On: while virtual keys are shown, a built-in blank IME takes over so the system keyboard cannot cover the screen or turn letters into Chinese\nRestores the previous IME when keys are hidden or the app exits\nRequires Shizuku authorization

① Start Shizuku and authorize it, then grant overlay permission
② Turn on “Show floating keys” and switch to the game

Toolbar:
· ≡ Drag the whole toolbar; long-press to hide the control menu (reopen the app to restore)
· Edit: keys can be dragged freely; tap a key to change its key/label/injection method or delete it
· ＋: Add a key; letters, digits, F1-F12, arrow keys, numpad and mouse keys are built in, and a custom key code can be entered
· Macro: tap once and then tap a custom key, enter a sequence such as Ctrl+Shift+K or W,Space,A
· Save / Load: save the current layout as a named preset, or load/delete presets
· One-key: master switch. Keys with “One-key switch” checked are hidden when the master switch is off and restored when it is on again
· Full: 5-row compact keyboard. When Caps is lit, Shift stays held; tap again to turn it off. “Sym” switches to the symbols/F1-F12 page. Drag the top ≡ to move; pinch with two fingers to resize
· Mouse: toggle the virtual mouse; drag with one finger on the touchpad to move the cursor, tap for left click, two-finger tap for right click, two-finger swipe to scroll, long-press to toggle left-button hold
· Mouse keys: always available, positioned at the virtual mouse

Injection methods:
· Keyboard event: cloud gaming / keyboard-enabled apps, can be held down
· Touch tap: native mobile games; the position stays touched while the key is held
· Mouse button: sends mouse button events at the virtual mouse position

Presets: the home screen can save/load multiple key layouts; “Export to file” writes a complete layout profile (keys, toolbar position, appearance and mouse settings, presets) and “Import from file” overwrites the current layout after confirmation
Keys are fixed to a dark background with a white border and do not change color when pressed
Keys not working, native touch not dragging, IME covering the screen…
Common issues and fixes, grouped by symptom.

· If a key does nothing in the game, tap “Edit” in the toolbar, tap the key and switch its injection method to “Touch tap”; keep “Keyboard event” for cloud gaming.\n· Make sure both dots on the status card are green.\n· In multi-touch mode, press the key’s actual position; you can still press keys while dragging the camera.
New keys do not respond while dragging the camera

This is not a permission issue but Android touch ownership: once the first finger lands on the game window, other fingers belong to the game and overlay keys never receive them.\nTurn on “Multi-touch” in the toolbar: keys stop stealing touches and are triggered by listening to raw touch coordinates, so you can press new keys while dragging.\nIn multi-touch mode the mouse left/right/middle buttons and wheel also work, and tapping an empty area acts as a left click. The joystick works the same way: press on the stick with one finger while another finger keeps dragging the camera.
IME covers the screen / letters turn into Chinese

Turn on “Block system IME” on the main screen: a built-in blank IME takes over while keys are shown, and the previous IME is restored when keys are hidden or the app exits.\nRequires Shizuku authorization.
Shizuku or overlay permission is not ready

Both dots on the status card must be green.\n· Shizuku requires version 11 or newer, and must be started again after a reboot.\n· Tap “Authorize Shizuku” when unauthorized, and “Grant overlay permission” when it is not granted.
Change key position, size and key code

Tap “Edit” in the toolbar to drag keys; tap a key to change its key code, label, size, shape, injection method, or delete it.\n“＋” adds keys: letters, digits, F1-F12, arrows, numpad and mouse buttons are built in. “Macro” binds a key sequence to one key.

“Presets” on the main screen saves/loads multiple layouts; “Export to file” writes a complete JSON profile (key layout, toolbar position, opacity, mouse sensitivity, toggles and presets) that you can back up or share, and “Import from file” shows a summary before overwriting the current layout.\n“Reset layout” clears custom keys.

Touch output point: reset to default position (right of the joystick)

In window mode, touch mode injects a finger at the output point to push the game’s own joystick. In edit mode a yellow crosshair appears on screen; drag it to the center of the game joystick. By default it sits to the right of the joystick so the joystick window does not cover it.\nIn multi-touch (hot zone) mode nothing is injected: fingers pass straight through to the game, so place the joystick pad directly on the game’s joystick.
